diagnosis: Deploy c19ab added an unbounded retry loop around the payment charge. When the provider returns "pending" — which it does under load — the server silently retries with linear backoff (0.8s, 1.6s, 2.4s...) until the charge settles.
The charge does eventually succeed, so the HTTP span returns 200 with status OK. Every error-rate and uptime monitor stays green. Nothing fires.
But the loop is awaited before the UI does anything, and PayButton.jsx never renders an interim state. For 6.8 seconds the customer sees a frozen button and no feedback.

184 sessions in the deploy window hit this path. They rage-clicked the Pay button an average of 3.7 times and left before the charge resolved. To them, a successful payment felt like a broken one — and monitoring had no way to see it.
causeLine: Deploy c19ab made success feel like failure: an invisible retry loop with no UI feedback.

fix.summary: Cap retries and render a pending state so the user always gets feedback.
